name: deep-research-orchestrator
description: Fans a research question across many OpenRouter models in parallel, cross-checks with an independent judge model, and returns a synthesized tiered brief. Callable by an agent swarm as a research tool.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Run a multi-model research panel with iterative deepening. Returns findings tiered A1/A2/B2/B3, conflicts surfaced explicitly, per-claim confidence %, remaining unknowns, and deduped sources. Use for any non-trivial question where a single model's answer is insufficient. Time/cost are not constrained; depth is preferred.

models.description: explicit OpenRouter model IDs; omit to use the reasoning tier

tools.name: model_panel
tools.description: Send one question to an explicit list of OpenRouter models and return each raw answer plus an independent judge model's cross-check (agreements, conflicts, unsupported claims).

tools.name: discover_opportunities
tools.description: SEM/SEO product/market opportunity research for a domain. Returns candidates ranked by priority % (value x winnability x fit) with keyword/intent data, corroborated chatter demand, competition gaps, monetization fit, and a how-to confidence %. Uses a 70/20/10 operator-domain/adjacent/wildcard effort split.

tools.name: research_bug
tools.description: Root-cause research for an error/signature. Triangulates across docs, issue trackers, CVEs, changelogs. Returns root cause, evidence, fix, regression test, and related risks.

resources.name: Model Tier Config
resources.description: Current role-tier to OpenRouter model mapping.

prompts.name: deep_research_this
prompts.description: Run a full multi-model deep-research panel on the given question.

prompts.name: find_high_value_products
prompts.description: Run SEM/SEO opportunity discovery for a domain.
